description:
The coastal regional Ekans keeps its familiar snake shape while its purple scales become neutral grey. It is Normal/Dark, using intimidation and Dark attacks rather than the original poison move set. Its origin is not established.

Dark substitutions replace poison moves; even Coil is replaced by Hone Claws. It evolves into regional Arbok at level 22.

Proposed roadside behavior: it takes cover where a stone edge meets tall grass, with only a section of grey coil visible against the stones. As heavy footfalls approach, it pulls into cover; when the exit is blocked, it raises the front of its body and holds the position before striking. Give that retreat somewhere to go. Someone setting a crate down in the grass may accidentally close it, turning the same animal from an avoidable presence into a threatened one. This is a territorial encounter, not evidence of poison, evil or a supernatural origin.

links.description: Existing regional road-grass encounters at levels 4–6; no new wild Arbok placement follows.
